incumbentReader.format: versioned CSV export library: csv-export-<NNN>/records.csv full-state snapshots (RFC 4180; header columns external_id* + payload_json* required, match_key/entity_type/deleted_at optional; JSON-array multi-value fields; deleted_at soft-delete tombstone rows)
edgeCasesCovered: quoted fields embedding commas, doubled quotes and line breaks
CRLF / LF / CR separators; missing trailing separator; UTF-8 BOM; blank lines
duplicate external ids (first wins, duplicate surfaced)
oversized payloads (> 256 KiB) with bounded+marked raw evidence
invalid UTF-8 rows (per-row rejection, never whole-file poisoning)
rows vanished without a tombstone (explicit disappeared-without-tombstone rejection)
unknown/garbage/missing base snapshot refs, broken headers, empty share (honest loud failures)
incumbentReader.credentialRef: opaque pass-through, recorded on reader.requests, never interpreted or stored

nativeReader.reads: the REAL W005 world_entities schema through the db port (embedded PGlite or node-postgres), tenant-scoped, keyed by world_entities.id, state = attributes
nativeReader.convergence: native catch-up carrying the identifier map's minted ids (the fixture mirror model made real — proven in migration-readers-real.test.ts)

verificationLeg.composition: createEdgeDeepActionTransport (the W084/W088 composition) + the in-memory edge runtime serving SIGNED edge jobs through the REAL file-share adapter re-reading the CSV
verificationLeg.executePosture: permanently refused by policy (rejected receipt) — read-only; the golden path asserts every edge job was an inspect

rejectionLedger.surface: captureSnapshot drains IncumbentRejectionSource and persists rejections inside the round transaction; listReaderRejections is the tenant-scoped audit read
rejectionLedger.countReconciliation: export data rows = staged + rejected (+ conflicted) — asserted per round in migration-readers.test.ts and migration-readers-real.test.ts
